Specification: This module is a small test specification for the community module Folds. The comments state that it is intended to test the Folds implementation and is only useful with a type checker because the implementation calls __NotSupportedByModelChecker. The specification defines trivial Init and Next operators as TRUE, and its main content is a LET/IN expression that builds a sequence of string sets, defines local helper operators, applies MapThenFoldSet over a finite set of indices, and checks that the resulting union is the set containing "b" and "c".
